pages.text: The neko world isn't just about combat and adventure — there's wonderful music and fun easter eggs waiting for you to discover~

The $(item)Kawaii Music Disc$() is a cute-style track created by homewool, lasting $(#FF69B4)121 seconds$().$(br2)This disc $(#FF69B4)cannot be crafted directly$() — you need to give gifts to neko NPCs for a chance to receive it as a return gift.$(br2)Pop it into a jukebox and fill the neko world with adorable melodies~

$(item)Furry Bohe$() is an $(#FF69B4)easter egg item$().$(br2)When harvesting mature $(item)Catnip$() crops, there's a very small chance (about 5%) of it dropping as a bonus.$(br2)The item's tooltip reads "Also try Furry Bohe" — as for what it actually does... perhaps it's an inside joke for a certain mysterious community?$(br2)$(#FFB6C1)Mysterious things always make you curious, don't they~$()
